mapper.select: SELECT status AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM `${resvTable}` GROUP BY status

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%d') AS day, COUNT(*) AS value FROM `${resvTable}` WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY day

SELECT r.id, r.username, s.start_at, s.end_at, s.item_id FROM `${resvTable}` r JOIN `${slotTable}` s ON r.slot_id=s.id WHERE r.status IN ('pending','confirmed') AND r.remind_sent=0 AND s.start_at > NOW() AND s.start_at <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{aheadMinutes} MINUTE)

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(start_at,'%Y-%m-%d') AS day, SUM(capacity) AS capacity, SUM(booked) AS booked FROM `${slotTable}` WHERE item_id=#{itemId} AND start_at LIKE #{monthLike} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(start_at,'%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY day
